patch.value: GH-1793: the merge driver refuses add/add of one importer-owned item with a deterministic external id, so a feature branch and a scheduled sync that import the same issue never merge cleanly

GitHub report https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1793 (pm 2026.11.24 merge drivers). Importers create items under deterministic ids derived from the external identity (pm-github writes <prefix>-github-<hash>-<N>). When two branches import the same external issue independently, both add the same item path with no common ancestor, and the field-aware driver refuses with 'Duplicate item identity: add/add item documents have no common ancestor ... assign distinct item ids'. For importer-owned ids that remedy is impossible, because the importer would recreate the id. Live case 2026-11-27: unbraind/pm-changelog PR 386 (issues 384 and 385), where the branch import held 20 evidence comments and sync PR 388 on main held only the import, resolved by hand. Expected: when both sides carry the same external identity (same importer-owned id plus matching github_url/external_ref or extension-declared identity fields, with importer provenance on both create events), merge field-aware. The earliest create is the base; comments, notes, files, docs and tests are unioned, de-duplicated by content plus timestamp; mirrored external fields take the newer import and local fields the side that changed them; history is re-recorded as a verifiable append-only chain. Different identities, or a side without importer provenance, keep today's refusal, and pm merge reconcile --dry-run reports the rule applied. Duplicate check: searched merge driver add/add duplicate item identity importer; no item owns same-identity add/add merges.

A fixture with two branches that each import the same external issue, one adding comments and status changes and the other a sync import, merges without conflict markers; the merged item carries both sides' comments, pm history --verify passes and a repeat import is a no-op; Add/add with different external identities or without importer provenance still refuses with today's message; The SDK exposes the identity rule so importer extensions declare their identity fields, and pm merge reconcile --dry-run names the rule it applied
Two branches that import the same external issue merge field-aware with a verifiable history
